transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements. I'll note any issues as we go and then make the binding production approval once we've heard from all four.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we lock anything. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's formally noted here since it isn't on Mara's draft lock sheet yet. This directly affects the current draft package, which calls for three cameras, so we need to confirm those three are the fixed wired positions.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue before we lock. The signed performance license I received this morning permits the gala broadcast but expressly prohibits any video-on-demand release and prohibits later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package, which permits the recording to be reused in the festival archive — that would constitute a video-on-demand release and is not allowed under the license. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but I'm disclosing it now so it's formally on the record before production approval. The festival archive reuse must be removed from the package.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical talent issue before we lock. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM, and the rider prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not in the production schedule. This directly conflicts with the current draft package, which includes a sponsor product display on stage — that must be removed. And the 3:00 PM soundcheck constraint needs to be formally added to the schedule before approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility issue before we lock. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. The Booth B assignment needs to be formally added before production approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
